description_en: Queries the ID of the protection rule group bound to a domain and the status of the intelligent rule hosting feature by calling DescribeDomainRuleGroup
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainRuleGroup查询域名绑定的防护规则组的ID及智能规则托管功能的启用状态
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-domain-rule-group --domain www.aliyundoc.com --instance-id waf-cn-tl32ast0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainRuleGroup

parameters.help_en:
The domain name to query.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html to query all domain names that have been added to WAF for protection
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的域名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html查询所有已接入WAF防护的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management. Default value: empty, which indicates the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

RuleGroupId.description_en:
The ID of the protection rule group bound to the domain. Valid values:

1011: the strict rule group built into WAF.
1012: the medium rule group built into WAF.
1013: the loose rule group built into WAF.

Other values indicate the IDs of custom rule groups
RuleGroupId.description_zh:
域名绑定的防护规则组的ID。取值：

1011：表示WAF内置的严格规则组。
1012：表示WAF内置的中等规则组。
1013：表示WAF内置的宽松规则组。

其他取值表示您自定义的规则组的ID

WafAiStatus.description_en:
The status of the intelligent rule hosting feature. Valid values:

0: disabled.
1: enabled
WafAiStatus.description_zh:
智能规则托管功能的启用状态。取值：

0：表示关闭。
1：表示开启
